MY BRIDGE WORKSHOP

My Bridge Prediction

Predict what will happen before putting blocks on your bridge.

Look, then try.

Choose which design you think will hold more blocks and explain why. Keep this first idea even if your result differs. There is no required winning design: a different result can reveal something about the folds, gap or paper.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

Work with a grown-up on a low surface. Use large lightweight blocks and stable, low supports. Keep fingers clear if the bridge slips. Never stand on the model bridge.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

ACTIVITY 1

My prediction

Draw the design you predict will hold more blocks.

Your ideas belong here. There is no score.

What are we learning?

A prediction is a reasoned idea to test, not a result that must come true.
